items.event_time_ist: Letter dated Oct 9, 2026; first reported Oct 13, 2026
items.summary: Iran's ambassador/permanent representative to the IMO filed a formal protest letter dated Oct 9, 2026 (filed end of last week) accusing US military forces of repeatedly occupying VHF Channel 16 in the Persian Gulf for prolonged periods, addressing Iranian seafarers in Persian with 'threatening, abusive and provocative' language, and in some cases urging crews to abandon their vessels. Iran says this disrupts the protected distress/safety channel (citing IMO Res. A.954(23) and SOLAS) and asked the IMO to circulate the letter as an official document to all member states. TradeWinds notes Iran offered no transcripts; US had not responded at publication. Maritime Executive adds IMO's conflict tally: 106 incidents, 24 fatalities since Feb 28, with 15 attacks in October.
items.title: Iran lodges formal IMO protest accusing US forces of misusing VHF Channel 16 to intimidate seafarers
